findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 2 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 44 questions numbered 1-44; by section: 2.1 2, 2.1.1 3, 2.1.2 8, 2.1.3 2, 2.1.4 7, 2.2 1, 2.2.1 2, 2.2.2 3, 2.2.3 5, 2.3 3, 2.4 3, 2.5 5.

Covers sections 2.1-2.5 in book order with 2-mark questions (definitions, values, domain and range, types of function, intercepts and intersections, root graphs, growth and decay); functions and numbers are changed from the book's examples and none repeats the unit's exercises. Comparison questions are answered as two-column tables. The range of a shifted square root follows the book correction (y >= c, not y >= 0). Every answer was checked by computation (sympy, check2_short.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
